name: Studio generates an editable outline proposal from a brief
description: A real brief submitted via 'Forge the outline' calls the AI outline endpoint and lands on an editable 'Outline proposal' page listing slide titles.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and stay on the default 'Studio — structured' tab.
In the 'A · Brief' textarea type: 'Series A pitch for a warehouse automation startup: problem, solution, market size, traction, team, and the ask'.
Verify a loading or busy state appears while the outline is being designed (the button shows a spinner or a message like 'Designing the outline…').
Within 60 seconds verify the app navigates to an 'Outline proposal' view with a deck title, a subtitle and a numbered list of slide rows.
Verify the outline contains at least 4 slide rows and every slide row has a non-empty title.
Click the 'Edit mode' button in the outline header.
Verify slide titles and briefs become editable inputs, and controls appear to add, remove, move and regenerate slides ('Add slide' button is visible).
Click 'Approve & write N slides' (the primary button at the bottom, where N matches the number of slides).
Verify a generation progress view appears, and eventually the editor/board opens with the slides rendered — do not fail if this takes up to 120 seconds.
